transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I messed up at work. I pushed ahead with this big onboarding launch we were planning. I committed company money and vendor time before any of the approvals were actually in place. At the time, I don't know, it just felt bold and completely necessary to get things moving. But now... now I'm on administrative leave, and everyone in HR is asking what I was thinking. So, my job told me I needed to come see someone.
Around the time you made those decisions, were you feeling unusually energized or high?

Yeah, I did. For the past few weeks, I've just felt... brilliantly alive, honestly. Like I was finally going to show leadership what HR can actually be. But at the same time, I'd get suddenly furious if anyone questioned me. Even over really minor things, like small edits to a document or just routine budget questions. I just... I had absolutely no patience for anyone slowing me down.
During these past few weeks, have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

No, I wouldn't say I've needed less sleep. I mean, I haven't really noticed a change in how much I'm sleeping, to be honest. I usually get around the same amount every night, and that hasn't seemed any different lately.
During this time, have you had experiences like hearing or seeing things other people couldn't, or beliefs that others said were not true?

No, nothing like that. I haven't heard any voices or seen anything that wasn't there. And I don't think I've had any strange beliefs, really... just that I felt really strongly about my ideas for work. But nobody told me I was out of touch with reality or anything, just that I was moving too fast and bypassing the rules.
Besides the problems at work, has this period caused serious problems in other parts of your life?

Well, the work stuff has definitely been the biggest issue. Because of how I handled the launch and... and all the arguments that came with it, I've actually been put on administrative leave. So, yeah, that's a pretty serious problem. They basically told me I'm no longer trusted to manage the HR projects I was leading. It's... it's a huge mess. But outside of work, no, I haven't really noticed any major problems in my personal life or anything like that. It's mostly just my job that's been affected.
During the past few weeks, have you been more driven than usual to start or push through projects or other activities?

Yeah, I definitely have. I've been trying to do a lot all at once. I was running the HR redesign at work, but outside of that, I was also trying to line up gallery partners, contact festival organizers, and fix several staff conflicts all at the exact same time. It just felt like... well, like every single idea I had needed to be acted on immediately.
During this period, did you feel more important, powerful, or unusually confident than you normally do?

Um, no, not really. I didn't feel more powerful or important than usual. I mean, I was confident in the plans I was pushing at work, but... just normal confidence, I think. I didn't feel like I was invincible or anything like that, just really focused on getting all those projects done.
During this period, were you talking more than usual or feeling like you couldn't stop talking?

Yes, I have. I've noticed that in meetings, I... well, I can actually hear myself talking faster and a lot longer than usual. I tend to just jump from topic to topic—like going straight from employee engagement to the gallery layouts, and then right into retention metrics. It got to the point where people practically had to raise their hands just to stop me and get a word in. So, yeah, I've definitely been talking a lot more than normal.
Before this recent period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt unusually energized or driven in a similar way?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where I was busy with work, sure, but... nothing like this. This past few weeks is the first time I've ever felt this constantly energized and, well, just completely driven to do so many things at once.
During these past few weeks, have you been more active than usual in social, creative, or other projects outside of work?

Yeah, definitely. It's been... a lot. I've been trying to run the whole HR redesign at work, but I'm also trying to line up gallery partners and contact festival organizers on the side. Plus, I'm trying to step in and fix several staff conflicts all at the same time. It just feels like... well, like every single idea I get has to be acted on immediately. So I'm just doing it all at once.
For how many days in a row have you been feeling this unusually energized and driven?
I'd say... well, it's been building for about a month now. It really started right around the time this new executive came in and began challenging my onboarding redesign.
If that new executive had not come in and challenged your redesign, do you think this energized, driven period would still have happened?

Honestly, I'm not really sure. It's... it's hard to say. Him coming in and pushing back on my work was definitely the spark that set it off, because I felt like I had to immediately prove him wrong. But... I don't know if I would have ended up feeling this way regardless. I just know that's exactly when it all started.
During this past month, have you been acting noticeably unlike your usual self?

I'm not really sure. I mean... I'm definitely a lot more intense right now with all these projects, like I just mentioned. But I haven't really noticed if I'm acting like a completely different person or anything. I think I'm just... well, just a lot more driven at the moment.
During this period, did your thoughts feel like they were racing?
No, not really. I mean, I have a lot on my mind with work and everything, but my thoughts aren't racing or anything like that. I'm just focused on getting things done.
Before this past month, have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had days where I felt down or stressed, especially with work, but nothing that lasted for two weeks straight or felt like I was depressed all day. I've always been pretty steady before all this started.
Did these changes start only after the new executive began challenging your work?
Yeah, I'd say so. It's been building for about a month now... pretty much right since the new executive started challenging my onboarding redesign. That's when all this really started.
Have other people told you that you've been acting noticeably different from your usual self during this past month?

No, not really. I mean... nobody has said anything like that to me. I think my colleagues just see that I'm putting in a lot of hours to defend this redesign. But no, no one has actually told me I'm acting out of character or anything.
During this past month, have you been more goal-directed than usual?

Yeah, I definitely have. I've been taking on a lot more than usual. Besides trying to run the HR redesign, I'm also lining up gallery partners and contacting festival organizers. And at work, I've been stepping in to fix several staff conflicts all at the same time. It just feels like... well, like every idea I get has to be acted on immediately.
During this past month, have you been more easily distracted than usual?

Yeah, I definitely have been. It's... well, it's hard to stay on one task. Like, I'll start reviewing an employee-relations file for work, and then I'll notice a color on a dashboard, or get a Slack ping, or suddenly have an idea for a display wall for my art, and it just pulls me completely off track. I end up jumping to the new thing before I ever finish the first one.
Have you ever had a period in your life when you felt depressed or down nearly every day for at least two weeks?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days like anyone else, but I haven't really felt down or depressed for weeks at a time. It's mostly just been this... this intense energy and focus lately. But no long stretches of feeling really sad or anything.
